newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ALPINE SKIING-WOMEN'S GIANT SLALOM MOVED TO CORTINA.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-WOMEN'S GIANT SLALOM MOVED TO CORTINA.

text.p: An World Cup women's giant slalom has been added to a busy programme of races at Cortina d'Ampezzo later this month the International Ski Federation on Tuesday.
The giant slalom, originally scheduled for December 22 in Morzine, France but postponed due to soft snow, will become the fourth race at the Italian resort.
A busy four days of racing will begin on January 23 with a downhill followed by a super giant slalom and two giant slaloms.
